answer: An operator running 134 keys therefore burns for 134 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the pigment quota and the oasis admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 11 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. Since the throttle counters live in the whisper ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
